title: Authentic Dense Italian Eggplant Lasagna
description: A classic Italian dish featuring char-grilled eggplant, rich tomato sauce, and a blend of cheeses, all combined in a dense and satisfying lasagna, with a hint of beer flavor and a smoky char-grill taste.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Char-grill the eggplant slices until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large skillet, combine the tomato sauce and beer, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, and parmesan cheese, and mix well.
Add the olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the cheese mixture, and mix until smooth.
Spread a layer of the tomato sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the cheese mixture over the noodles.
Add a layer of char-grilled eggplant slices on top of the cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the tomato sauce, then the remaining cheese mixture, and finally another layer of eggplant.
Top the lasagna with the shredded mozzarella cheese.
